title: What Remains Where We Are
style: Funk; crisp syncopated bass, clipped rhythm guitar, dry electric piano, tight horn stabs, hand percussion and punchy drums; clear intimate female lead with sparse call-and-response verses, rising horn pre-choruses and stacked backing vocals; danceable midtempo groove; warm analog saturation, restrained room ambience, full-band bass-and-vocal bridge return
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Five little records on a wooden shelf
Each one carrying a piece of myself
A hug in the quiet, a page under seal
A ledger that counts what the body can feel

[Pre-Chorus]
You can lock up the paper
You can swallow the sound
But the truth keeps a rhythm
When nobody's around

[Chorus]
It keeps on moving, moving through me
No clean ending, no decree
What we bury learns the way
Through the night and into day
It keeps on moving, moving on
Not a victory, not gone
Every morning, every scar
Says we are what remains where we are

[Verse 2]
The machine took a name and returned a number
Filed the living under somebody's order
The scripts stayed closed while the ballroom turned
Pages held fire, but the edges burned

[Pre-Chorus]
You can blame the weather
You can blame the years
But a locked little archive
Still remembers tears

[Chorus]
It keeps on moving, moving through me
No clean ending, no decree
What we bury learns the way
Through the night and into day
It keeps on moving, moving on
Not a victory, not gone
Every morning, every scar
Says we are what remains where we are

[Bridge]
Between the worlds, I count the files
Folded-up dreams in measured piles
I won't call the wound a door
I won't ask it to be more
No grand release, no final flame
Just waking up and naming my name

[Breakdown]
Say it softly
Say it plain
Some things leave
Some things remain

[Final Chorus]
It keeps on moving, moving through me
No clean ending, no decree
What we bury learns the way
Through the night and into day
It keeps on moving, moving on
Not a victory, not gone
Every morning, every scar
Says we are what remains where we are

[Outro]
The shelf is full, the room is still
The heart keeps time against its will
No answer folded in the drawer
Just one more morning than before
